thread:
Maya: bringing up Spectra14B-lite, int4 conversion shows repeating tokens after ~120 tokens on longform tests.
Liam: ugh, repeating. config you used?
Maya: converter v2, default quant pack, --quant=int4, tried proj-order=qk_to_kv and kv_to_qk. repeat spikes only with one proj-order variant.
Cheng: can you paste the eval command?
Maya: ```bash
./bin/redwood-eval \\n  --model /mnt/models/spectra14b/converted/int4/ \\n  --promptset evals/longform/critique.jsonl \\n  --batch 4 \\n  --max-tokens 1024 \\n  --proj-order=qk_to_kv
```
triage-bot: [8820000005] quick-smoke: 40 prompts, repeat_rate=10.8%, ppl_delta=+0.85 vs fp16.
Liam: that smells like kv cache stride/head ordering mismatch rather than tokenizer. Did you run token checksum?
Maya: token checksums match on shortcases. embedding sums ok. but kv dumps show permutation for some heads.
Andrea: Spectra checkpoints use headconcat=true and an implicit reshape in checkpoint -> exporter path often folds dims early. int4 packing might be reordering bytes.
Cheng: I dumped k/v matrices for step 1 and step 128 and compared; here's excerpt (redacted): {"k_1":"...base64...","k_128":"...rotated_base64..."} - looks like a cyclic shift across head groups.
Liam: try conversion with --preserve-proj-order and disable eager packing. also regen calibration stats.
Maya: re-run with flags: ```bash
python -m redwood.convert \\n  --src /mnt/checkpoints/spectra14b \\n  --dst /mnt/models/spectra14b/converted/int4_preserve \\n  --quant int4 \\n  --preserve-proj-order \\n  --pack-mode delayed
```
triage-bot: [8820000033] smoke: 40 prompts, repeat_rate=1.6%, ppl_delta=+0.05.
Maya: great improvement. will run full longform hallucination and rouge/bertscore suite overnight.
Andrea: hypothesis: exporter did reshape -> pack -> transpose; pack (int4 nibble packing) made transpose non-commutative when headconcat was present.
Liam: filed a tiny test in converter that asserts pre/post conversion attention weight reordering equality for random seed. PR: https://git.local/r/redwood/convert/issue/542
Cheng: saved all artifacts: /mnt/onboard/spectra14b/artifacts/8819999999/ (kv_dumps.tar.gz, token_checksums.txt, convert_log.txt).
Maya: next steps: full eval, run rotary frequency scaling comparison vs fp16 (we saw minor bias on sentiment prompts), and check for prob mass drift on long-range QA.
Andrea: tag @ops for GPU slot tomorrow, and maybe @docs to note converter caveat. :memo:
Maya: thanks — will post summary + repro script when full eval done.
